intro: This quest marks your first official trial under Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill to prove yourself worthy of joining the People's Militia. With Stormwind's throne distracted and its army absent, local volunteers have taken up arms to defend Westfall against the brazen Defias Brotherhood. Your initial task sends you across the northern fields and mines to cull the outlaws choking local farmland.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The People's Militia has but one goal: To defend the lands of Westfall and return peace to our surroundings. Unfortunately, the price of peace is often blood.

One of my scouts has brought word of a band of Defias Trappers wreaking havoc nearby. I have reports of Defias Trapper sightings near the Jangolode Mine to the Northwest as well as at the Molsen Farm and Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm. If you seek to join our ranks, slay 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Perhaps I did not make myself clear, pledge. In order to prove your worth as a servant to The People's Militia and to the Light you need to slay 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to me when the deed is done.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. My scout witnessed your valiant acts. You are proving yourself quite well so far.
